_comment: Sample config. Pass with --config. CLI flags override these. For a Kotlin/Fabric mod keep rewriteKotlinMetadata=true and list your root package(s).
_targeted: Optional: encrypt ONLY matching strings (e.g. hide just a URL). Leave both empty for normal behaviour. Set stringEncryptionChance:0 to encrypt ONLY these.
_mba: Mixed Boolean-Arithmetic: rewrite int AND long +,-,^,|,& operations as equivalent bit/arith identities (bit-exact under overflow), polymorphic (random identity per site). Hides the arithmetic itself, not just constants.
_numcondy: Hide int/long LDC constants behind CONSTANT_Dynamic (crazy/NC bootstrap) — a decompiler sees an opaque dynamic constant instead of the literal. Needs class v55+ (Java 11); older classes skipped.
_opaque: Argument-driven opaque predicates: always-true guards computed from a real int argument (harder to constant-fold than a field guard); the impossible branch is dead.
_hiding: Opt-in extra hardening. hideStringsCondy hides string literals behind CONSTANT_Dynamic (no plaintext, no visible decoder; needs class v55+, else falls back to inline decoder). antiDecompile wraps methods in behaviour-neutral opaque handlers that confuse CFR/Vineflower (does NOT hide from javap). hideReferences routes internal calls through invokedynamic (crazy/Indy) so the call graph disappears. Test the obfuscated jar before shipping.
_byteinject: Byte injection: write junk class-file attributes the JVM silently ignores (JVMS 4.7.1) — defeats raw-byte signature/fingerprint scanners and trips naive attribute parsers; decoy names impersonate real toolchain attributes. Does NOT hide from a structured decompiler.
_antitamper: Runtime self-integrity: bake each class's CRC32 into an injected verifier (crazy/IT) and re-check at load; throw if edited. Raises the bar vs jar-patching. NOT a security boundary and INCOMPATIBLE with Java agents / load-time bytecode transformers — leave off unless you know the runtime. Deliberately excluded from --crazy.
